sights.w: The village-run day spa of Makkari: a rock-built rotenburo with Mt Yōtei filling the view.

sights.n: Yōtei Nature Park & Yōtei Spring, Makkari (羊蹄山自然公園・羊蹄の湧水)
sights.w: Park at the Makkari trailhead of Mt Yōtei; by the entrance the 'kamui wakka' spring pours water filtered for decades through the volcano — locals queue with bottles.

sights.address: Niseko / Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: 'Sulphur mountain' in Ainu — the youngest volcano of the Niseko range, its bare slopes crusted with sulphur crystals; a short hike from Goshiki Onsen with views to Yōtei.
